title: Spend the fast-tier protocol fees
body: Gov.Claim-Protocol pays every protocol fee accrued when it applies to the recipient. Never to the DAO, the fast-tier process or the token. Signer fees are never governance's to move. It moves money or code, so it carries Effective-At (filled by dao-propose: the vote's end + 24 h + 1 day of margin); it takes effect only then, when anyone sends Gov.Apply, and until then validators may leave by the exit hatch (Exit-Now) and the DAO may cancel it (Gov.Cancel).
